name: GitHub Innovation Graph
measures: Git pushes, developers and repositories by quarter
about: GitHub publishes quarterly activity on its platform by country. We add up countries to get a worldwide figure for git pushes.
attribution: Data from the GitHub Innovation Graph, released under CC0 1.0.
limitations: Small country figures may be left out, so totals can be slightly low.
AI agents and automation also push code, so this shows activity, not human demand.
